resale_co.name: Certificate of Continued Occupancy (CCO)
resale_co.issued_by: Borough Zoning Official (Frank Sacco, Zoning/Code Enforcement Official)
requirements: Property must meet the Borough Property Maintenance Code (2018 International Property Maintenance Code, Chapter 151)
Rental units: a current CCO must be attached to the Borough landlord registration (Chapter 152)

fees.label: Certificate of continued occupancy
fees.quote: The fee for a certificate of continued occupancy, as per Chapter 151, Property Maintenance, shall be $25.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Contact the Borough Zoning Official, Frank Sacco, at Borough Hall (1700 Rt 54) to request the certificate of continued occupancy and pay the $25 fee. He holds office hours Mondays 5:00 to 7:00 PM. The Borough code does not publish a form, a lead time or the exact sale trigger, so call ahead to confirm.

resale_co.notes: Folsom's code (ecode360, read 2026-10-04) sets a $25 fee for a certificate of continued occupancy, handled by the Zoning Official, and requires a current CCO for every registered rental. Chapter 151 adopts the 2018 International Property Maintenance Code but the code text does not spell out when a CCO is triggered on a sale, so we list it as required and tell buyers and sellers to confirm with the Zoning Official. Construction code work is done by the State DCA Construction Office (609-567-3653, marie.reese@dca.nj.gov), which is not the CCO issuer. Smoke/CO certificates come from the State (see fire section).

requirements: Secondary power source identification label for homes with solar, generators or batteries (the State application is now the CSACMASPSIL)

authorities.name: NJ DCA Division of Fire Safety, Bureau of Fire Code Enforcement
authorities.lead_time: More than 10 business days before closing for the lowest fee

fees.label: More than 10 business days before closing
fees.quote: If you are applying for a certificate more than ten business days from the closing date the fee is $45 dollars

fees.label: 4 to 10 business days before closing
fees.quote: if applying 4 to 10 business days from the closing date the fee is $90

fees.label: Less than 4 business days before closing
fees.quote: if the closing date is less than four business days the fee is $161.

authorities.how_to_apply: Apply online through the NJ DCA Fire Safety portal (Apply Smoke Certification). Pay by e-check or credit card before submitting; a valid email address is required. The certificate is emailed once the application is submitted, the fee is paid and any required inspections are done.
authorities.contact_title: Bureau Chief, Bureau of Fire Code Enforcement (listed as the Fire Official for Folsom in the state fire directory)

fire_cert.notes: NJ DCA lists Folsom as State enforced (S) and its July 17, 2026 list marks it 'SC' (the State issues smoke certificates). The Borough's Construction Office page links sellers to the State Fire Safety portal. Fire suppression is by the Collings Lakes Fire Department (not the certificate issuer). The directory lists (609) 633-6132; the Bureau's page lists (609) 633-6106 for Louis Kilmer. BFCE_CSDCMAC@dca.nj.gov is the address the State application gives for smoke/CO certificate questions about electric-heat homes.
